Package aor.proj3t.util.authutils

Class JwtUtil

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.util.authutils.JwtUtil
@ApplicationScoped public class JwtUtil extends Object
Utility class for handling JWT (JSON Web Tokens) operations. This class provides methods for generating and validating JWT tokens used for authentication and authorization throughout the application.

    • generateTwoFactorLoginToken

      public String generateTwoFactorLoginToken(Long userId, String userEmail, String ipAddress)
      Generate a temporary token for two-factor authentication during login. This token has limited scope and can only be used to complete 2FA verification.
      Parameters:
      userId - The user ID requiring 2FA
      userEmail - The user email
      ipAddress - The IP address of the client
      Returns:
      The temporary JWT token for 2FA completion
